01 —

It starts at 3 a.m. on the George Washington Bridge

At just after three in the morning, a black Tahoe smashed Victor Kaine's cab through the barrier on the George Washington Bridge, with three drunk grad students in the back seat. It seems Victor's ex-employers have burned his accounts, frozen his assets and put a seven-figure bounty on his head.

So Victor Kaine does the only thing left to a man with a price on his head: he goes to ground — as the new Battle Magic instructor at Ravenwick Academy. The students think he's a master Battle Mage. He's really just a master of the 9mm. They have fireballs. He has a Glock.
